name: Kokiri Sword
obtain: A chest in the Kokiri Forest training clearing, reached by crawling through a gap.
verdict: A must before you enter the Great Deku Tree.
notes: In the remake swords no longer hit walls or collect Rupees (an engine limit). Hold Y and release for a spin attack.

name: Master Sword
obtain: The pedestal in the Temple of Time, with the three Spiritual Stones and the Ocarina of Time.
verdict: Your adult sword for the rest of the game.
notes: Redesigned in the Skyward Sword style. Drawing it sends you seven years into the future; put it back in the pedestal to become a child again.

name: Giant's Knife
obtain: In the base game Medigoron sells it to adult Link in Goron City. The remake has it, but the price is not yet confirmed.
notes: Two-handed: no shield. It breaks after a few hits and becomes the Broken Giant's Knife, which is much weaker.

name: Biggoron Sword
obtain: The end of the adult trading sequence: hand the Biggoron Receipt to Biggoron at the summit of Death Mountain.
verdict: The strongest sword; worth it on a 100% run.
notes: Two-handed (no shield) and it never breaks.

name: Deku Shield
obtain: The Kokiri Forest shop. Shops charge more in the remake: price not yet confirmed.
notes: It burns: if you lose it, buy another.

name: Hylian Shield
obtain: The Castle Town Bazaar; there is also one in a grave in Kakariko Graveyard (not yet confirmed for the remake).
notes: Redesigned in the Skyward Sword style. It does not burn. Works for both ages; as a child it covers almost all of you, but in the remake you drown if you crouch behind it underwater.

name: Mirror Shield
obtain: The Spirit Temple, on one of the colossus's hands, after beating an Iron Knuckle (adult side).
notes: It reflects light: you need it for the Spirit Temple mirrors and against Twinrova. In the remake it also reflects Beamos beams.

name: Deku Stick
obtain: Deku Babas, grass and the Kokiri Forest shop.
notes: It breaks when you hit things. Light it on a torch to light others or burn webs. It is wooden: Bari and Biri cannot shock you through it.

name: Deku Nut
obtain: Deku Scrubs, grass and the Kokiri Forest shop.
notes: Throw it and its flash stuns nearby enemies. Works for both ages.

name: Fairy Slingshot
obtain: A chest inside the Great Deku Tree.
notes: Fires Deku Seeds. In the remake you aim over the shoulder, with buttons or motion controls, and you can move while aiming.

name: Boomerang
obtain: A chest inside Lord Jabu-Jabu.
notes: Stuns enemies, cuts tentacles and fetches far-off items (Skulltula tokens included).

name: Fairy Bow
obtain: A chest in the Forest Temple.
notes: Fires Arrows. Takes Fire, Ice and Light Arrows. Over-the-shoulder aiming with optional motion controls, like the Fairy Slingshot.

name: Hookshot
obtain: The race against Dampé's ghost under Kakariko Graveyard, as an adult.
notes: Pulls you to wooden targets and stuns enemies.

name: Longshot
obtain: The Water Temple, after beating Dark Link.
notes: Twice the Hookshot's reach; it replaces it.

name: Megaton Hammer
obtain: A chest in the Fire Temple.
notes: Smashes rocks, pounds rusty switches and stuns Volvagia.

name: Bombs
obtain: The Bomb Bag from Dodongo's Cavern; after that, buy them or find them in pots.
notes: They open cracked walls and grottos, which the remake shows as cracked ground or rocks. Before the bag you can use Bomb Flowers with the Goron Bracelet.

name: Bombchus
obtain: The Bombchu Shop and Bombchu Bowling Alley in Castle Town; the House of Skulltula gives 20 for 40 tokens (not yet confirmed for the remake).
notes: They run along floors and walls before blowing up: they reach cracks a bomb cannot.

name: Fire Arrows
obtain: Lake Hylia, as an adult: with the lake full, shoot an arrow at the sun as it rises, from the platform above the Water Temple entrance.
notes: They use magic as well as arrows. They light far-off torches.

name: Ice Arrows
obtain: The final chest of the Gerudo Proving Grounds.
notes: They use magic and freeze enemies. Optional.

name: Light Arrows
obtain: Zelda gives them to you in the Temple of Time when she reveals herself after the Spirit Temple.
notes: They use magic. Essential against Ganondorf and Ganon.
